ops.title: fusekit verification gate MUST run `-tags fuse` TESTS, not just the fuse build — fuse-callback tests (holderfs treeview, mountset) are otherwise never exercised
ops.body:
The fusekit (and cc-pool) verification gate must run the `-tags fuse` **tests**, not only `go build -tags fuse`. The fuse-callback tests — `holderfs` (treeview/synth/mux fileid + attr callbacks) and the root-package `mountset` fuse tests — are guarded by `//go:build fuse` and **do not run** under the default `./scripts/test.sh ./...`. A gate of `go vet + ./scripts/test.sh ./... + CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./... + go build -tags fuse ./...` (build-only for the fuse tag) passes green while a fuse-tagged test is broken.

**Why:** On 2026-07-10 v0.38.0 shipped with a pre-existing ~1% flaky `holderfs` test (`TestTreeViewLateIdentityRekeysMintedIno`, nondeterministic minted-fileid resolution) because every workflow gate this session (amend synth, whole-diff synth, freeze refuter, my local pre-tag gate) built the fuse tag but only ran default-tag tests. CI's separate "Test (fuse callbacks)" job caught it right after the tag push.

**How to apply:** add `./scripts/test.sh -tags fuse ./holderfs/... .` (holderfs + the root mountset package) to every fusekit release/verify gate, and require agents' gates to run fuse-tagged tests — not just build them. The flake root-cause fix rides [[claude-pool-project]]'s v0.38.1. Related: [[vm-validation-10min-window]] (kernel-panic paths still need the VM harness beyond any go test).
